mapper.select: SELECT id, strategy_type, name, enabled, cron_expression, channel, target_mode, message_template, config_json, created_at, updated_at FROM smart_push_strategy WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, strategy_type, name, enabled, cron_expression, channel, target_mode, message_template, config_json, created_at, updated_at FROM smart_push_strategy WHERE strategy_type = #{strategyType} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, strategy_type, name, enabled, cron_expression, channel, target_mode, message_template, config_json, created_at, updated_at FROM smart_push_strategy WHERE strategy_type = 'birthday' AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, strategy_type, name, enabled, cron_expression, channel, target_mode, message_template, config_json, created_at, updated_at FROM smart_push_strategy WHERE strategy_type = 'scheduled' AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, strategy_type, name, enabled, cron_expression, channel, target_mode, message_template, config_json, created_at, updated_at FROM smart_push_strategy WHERE strategy_type = 'on_event' AND enabled = 1 AND config_json->>'triggerEvent' = #{triggerEvent} ORDER BY id ASC
